recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of a long-haired male figure in a white tank top and leather jacket, positioned against a chain-link fence and industrial post, featuring bold, stacked sans-serif typography in a deep plum hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair framing a pale face against a metallic background
Vertical industrial post balancing the subject's off-center position
Deep plum text contrasting with the desaturated, near-monochrome image
Diagonal lines of the chain-link fence adding texture and depth
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with a slight warm tint
Urban industrial setting with chain-link textures
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, medium shot from chest up, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, highlighted by the brightest values in the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the white tank top, then up to the bold text in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Occupied by the chain-link fence on the left and industrial textures on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and off-whites (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white shirt and black jacket.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to desaturated tones and one specific accent color

treatment.shadow: Subtle dark drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence.
Offers a similar grotesque feel with high impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated, high-contrast photograph of a man with long dark wavy hair, wearing a white tank top and a black leather jacket. He is leaning against a chain-link fence with an industrial metal post visible. The lighting should be dramatic, highlighting his facial features. The overall tone should be gritty and reminiscent of 1990s rock photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply four lines of stacked, left-aligned text in the top-left corner using an extra-bold condensed sans-serif font. The color should be a deep, muted plum. Ensure the text has a very subtle dark drop shadow to separate it from the fence texture.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a deep plum?
Is the background desaturated but not purely black and white?
Is the font heavy and condensed?
Is the subject's hair dark and voluminous?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any specific brand logos on the jacket or fence
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper text alignment in the top-left.
Ensure the chain-link fence texture is clearly visible.
Verify the desaturated color grading is consistent across the image.
Confirm the leather jacket texture is distinct from the hair.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated urban portrait with heavy, stacked, color-accented sans-serif typography in the upper-left quadrant.
